title: Unique top-level JSON keys
failure_signature: model repeats a required top-level JSON key
model emits a second copy of a top-level JSON field
prompt_delta: Emit exactly one top-level JSON object. Emit every required top-level key exactly once. Do not repeat, redefine, append a second copy of, or emit multiple occurrences of any top-level key. Before finishing, ensure the object contains one and only one occurrence of each required key.
validator_expectations: duplicate top-level JSON keys must not appear
